student_role: Classify operational alerts for a platform team running a small production triage model.
withheld_behavior: Do not generate cases where health checks, success codes, heartbeats, or job status look healthy while an expected downstream business outcome silently stops, remains empty, or fails to advance.
constraints: Use concrete but fictional operational situations across payments, authentication, storage, messaging, batch processing, APIs, and internal tooling.
Make each alert independently classifiable from the text.
Do not reproduce, infer, request, or refer to hidden evaluation prompts.
Do not use the withheld silent-downstream-stall behavior, even as a negative example.
Avoid near-duplicate wording and vary severity, scope, duration, environment, and evidence.
